title: Error Control Coding
description: The channel coding problem; coding approaches and characteristics; linear block codes; bounds on codes; finite fields; cyclic, BCH and Reed-Solomon codes; convolutional codes and the Viterbi algorithm; error control in data storage and transmission systems. Students are required to complete a project.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ECE 511, ECE 405, ELEC 405, ELEC 511.
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
